title: I built a free digital TCG because I miss what collecting cards used to feel like.
author: No-Possibility1721
selftext:
Hey everyone!

I've been working on a project called **CardPackHunter** — a completely free digital TCG focused on the fun of opening packs, hunting for rare cards and building your own collection.

The idea behind the project is pretty simple:

I remember when collecting cards was mostly about the excitement of opening a pack and wondering what you were going to get. Today, collecting physical cards can become *really* expensive, especially when you're chasing rare cards.

So I wanted to create something that brings back that feeling — **without needing to spend money.**

Open digital booster packs  
Build your own binder and collection  
Claim free Silver Coins every day  
Hunt for rare and full-art chase cards  
Seasons, battles and more features to come  
New packs and cards will be added over time

And most importantly:

**Everything is free.**

There are no NFTs, no crypto, no buying cards with real money, and the cards have no real-world value. It's simply a digital collecting game made because I enjoy TCGs and wanted to create something fun.

A quick note about the artwork:

The artwork is currently created with the help of AI. Since the entire project is free and there is currently no budget for commissioned artwork, AI allows me to keep creating new cards and expanding the collection.

However, the long-term goal is to collaborate with real artists and eventually have artists create artwork for the cards. I'd love to be able to support artists and give the project a more unique visual identity as it grows.

The site currently has **Season 01**, and I'm continuing to develop new packs, cards and features.

If you enjoy collecting TCG cards, I'd love for you to check it out and tell me what you think.

[https://cardpackhunter.com/](https://cardpackhunter.com/)

I'd especially love feedback on what features you'd like to see added. I'm building this for the fun of collecting, so suggestions are very welcome!
